$doc: The stack profile. Every path, package and command in this kit is read from here. Run /adapt to refresh it after a framework upgrade or a move. Reference: obsidian/architecture/stack-profile.md
notes: Styling is styled-components, not a CSS token file. The design tokens are TypeScript: src/styles/colors.ts declares the literal palette (_colors) and toVars() turns it into var(--color-*) references that printVars() emits into :root inside src/styles/index.ts. That is a two-tier system (primitive -> CSS var), not the kit's three-tier convention, so conventions.tokenTiers is false. See ADR-0101.

Responsive sizing goes through the SmartCSSGrid helpers rm()/em()/media from src/styles (src/styles/grid/grid.tsx), which scale px values against a 1920/1440/768/576 grid. A raw px in a styled-component is usually a bug; use rm().
paths.assets is null on purpose: content assets are served from Strapi through the API layer, and public/ holds only 3D models, textures, fonts, favicons/PWA icons and OG images.

paths.env is null: there is no validated env module yet. 52 process.env reads are scattered across src, so verify.sh will FAIL the env check until one exists. This is known debt, not a mis-detection. See ADR-0104.

The code reads NEXT_PUBLIC_BASEURL (no underscore between BASE and URL) in 10 places while .env declares NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL. Only src/utils/strapi.ts reads the underscored name. Every canonical URL, sitemap entry and OG tag is therefore falling through to the hardcoded 'https://www.streetbarbell.com' literal.

paths.protected covers the two vendored engines from the next14-starter: src/components/Text (TextEngine 1381 lines, TextProgress 834 lines, TLine) and src/components/Springs (Spring, Inview, SpringTrigger, Hover, Handle, ProgressTrigger). Consume and wrap them; do not edit them without sign-off.

There is no single shared rAF ticker. src/hooks/useLoop.ts starts one requestAnimationFrame per subscriber and src/layouts/ScrollLayout drives Lenis on its own loop. This deviates from the kit's one-loop rule (ADR-0005). See ADR-0103.

i18n is next-intl with locale-prefixed routes under src/app/[locale]. The locale list has three sources that must agree: src/config/locales.ts (static, used by middleware and Edge), NEXT_PUBLIC_LOCALES, and Strapi via src/utils/locales.ts.
commands.typecheck is not a package.json script; tsc runs through npx. There is no test command.

commands.start is NOT `yarn start`: next.config.mjs sets output:'standalone', and Next refuses to run `next start` against it. A local production run needs `yarn build`, then `cp -R public .next/standalone/public`, `cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static`, then `cd .next/standalone && node server.js`. Verified 2026-09-17.

next.config.mjs config trap: never put a package that a client component's import graph can reach into experimental.serverComponentsExternalPackages. An ESM package externalised there (axios 1.11 was) makes every importer an async webpack module, and an async client reference resolves to undefined in Next 14.2's SSR flight client — every page 500s with 'Element type is invalid' and nothing in the message names the config. See ADR-0106.

The Draco decoder is vendored at public/draco/ (from three/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf) and reached through DRACO_DECODER_PATH in src/utils/dracoDecoder.ts. Refresh it when three is upgraded. See ADR-0108.

3D scene performance: src/utils/deviceTier.ts owns per-tier DPR and renderer flags (read once at construction), src/utils/warmupScene.ts owns the prewarm, and the loader curtain in src/layouts/AssetsLoaderLayout/Loader.tsx waits for every scene a view registered with useRequireScene. See ADR-0107.

Both yarn.lock and package-lock.json are committed. yarn.lock is the one that is actually maintained (last touched 2025-09-03 vs 2025-08-26) and the README documents yarn. Treat package-lock.json as stale.
